name: markdown-preview-mention
description: Insert a Claude Code @-mention for the lines selected in a Markdown preview.

commands.title: Markdown Preview Mention: Insert @-Mention for the Preview Selection

enumDescriptions: Paste the reference into the focused Claude chat input. No editor tab ever opens, but only one chat receives it, and a chat that is still starting may miss it.

Paste when exactly one Claude chat tab is visible. Otherwise use Claude Code's own delivery, which opens a new chat or mentions in every visible chat; the first time, it opens the source file beside the preview and leaves it open.

Always use Claude Code's own delivery: the same result as Cmd+L in a text editor, including the highlighted chip. The first press opens the source file beside the preview and leaves it open; later presses reuse it.
markdownPreviewMention.delivery.markdownDescription: How the reference reaches the Claude Code chat. Claude Code only accepts a mention from a text editor's selection, so `paste` never opens an editor, while `claude` opens the source file beside the preview (once, then reuses it) to use Claude's own delivery. A chat in the side bar is not visible to the tab check, so `pasteWithFallback` treats it as no chat.
